mapper.select: SELECT * FROM score WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} ORDER BY student_id
SELECT * FROM score WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (subject_id, student_id, student_name, score, updated_at) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{score}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE score SET score = #{score}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM score ORDER BY subject_id, student_id

SELECT sc.id AS scoreId, sc.student_id AS studentId, sc.student_name AS studentName, sc.score, s.name AS subjectName, t.name AS teacherName FROM score sc JOIN subject s ON sc.subject_id = s.id JOIN teacher t ON s.teacher_id = t.id WHERE sc.score = '0' OR sc.score = '100'

SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(score AS DECIMAL) >= 90 THEN '优秀' WHEN CAST(score AS DECIMAL) >= 80 THEN '良好' WHEN CAST(score AS DECIMAL) >= 60 THEN '及格' ELSE '不及格' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM score GROUP BY name
SELECT DATE(updated_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM score WHERE updated_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY DATE(updated_at) ORDER BY date
SELECT s.subject_id, su.name AS subject_name, s.score FROM score s JOIN subject su ON s.subject_id = su.id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT sc.score FROM score sc JOIN student st ON sc.student_id = st.student_id WHERE st.class_name = #{className} AND sc.subject_id = #{subjectId}
SELECT sc.score FROM score sc JOIN student st ON sc.student_id = st.student_id WHERE st.grade = #{grade} AND sc.subject_id = #{subjectId}
